messages:
Jenna (People Ops): hi team :wave: quick q — we have a new hire who started 10/15 and missed the floating holiday earlier this month. Manager asked if we can reallocate that floating day into their PTO bank pro-rated for partial year. Is that allowed and what docs do we need?

Alex K.: Hmm, for partial-year hires we normally prorate annual PTO but floating holidays are date-specific. We have done 1-off manager exceptions before. Need manager sign-off + People Ops approval. @Ruth (Manager) can you confirm the ask? :thinking:

Ruth (Manager): Yep — I want to offer a 1-day reallocation so they don't feel left out. Happy to sign off.

Maria P.: Quick policy check — floating holidays expire at year-end and are not automatically carried over. Exceptions are allowed with manager + People Ops approval and must be documented in the employee file. If approved, we convert the floating holiday to a PTO credit of 1 day and adjust accruals. :white_check_mark:

Jasper L.: From a systems POV here's what needs to happen:
1) Create an exception record in HRIS with the manager approval note.
2) Adjust current PTO balance: +1 day.
I can do the HR entry if you give the go-ahead. Example command we run internally:
```
hrcli adjust-balance --user sam.harris --add 1 --type PTO --note "Floating holiday reallocation per manager exception"
```

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Floating holidays expire at year-end and are non-transferable by default. Exceptions must include manager approval and a documented reason. Audit trail required. See: https://redwood.example/hr/policy/floating-holidays

Alex K.: Also check blackout dates — next sprint includes company-wide code freeze + 11/23 bank holiday. Make sure team coverage is OK. Sometimes better to swap a teammate's day instead of topping up PTO.

Jenna (People Ops): Thanks — Ruth, please drop a single-line approval here like "approve reallocation of 1 floating holiday to PTO for Sam H." and I'll process. I'll ask Jasper to run the HR command after approval. :thumbsup:

Ruth (Manager): approve reallocation of 1 floating holiday to PTO for Sam H.

Jasper L.: Got it — running the adjustment now and attaching the approval note.

Jasper L.: Done. Filed exception id EXC-2024-412, adjusted balance +1 PTO day in HRIS. cc @Jenna (People Ops)

Jenna (People Ops): Great, closing out. I'll update the manager playbook with the workflow: exception requires manager sign-off + People Ops entry in HRIS. TL;DR: allowed as exception, document it, and watch blackout coverage. :memo:
